create_tagged_tasks_container: create a TaggedTasks container to store factory functions with associated tags
add_tagged_function: use the TaggedTasks add decorator to register a factory function with multiple tags
query_tagged_functions: query the TaggedTasks container to get all functions matching a set of tags
list_all_tags: list all available tags registered in the TaggedTasks container
access_task_by_name: access a registered factory function from TaggedTasks by its name using bracket notation
